document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Under thick sheets of ice, your flashlight gives tantalizing 
glimpses of strange alien devices, but you cannot fathom their use 
or purpose. If only you had more time and more equipment you 
could plunder these ancient marvels! For now, you quickly make 
a note about their location, and then find your way back to 555.
(555)
